newsitem.title: USA: US sets meeting on natgas royalty-in-kind program.
newsitem.headline: US sets meeting on natgas royalty-in-kind program.

text.p: The U.S. Mineral Management Service said Friday it scheduled a public meeting for May 14 on the natural gas royalty-in-kind program.
The meeting is to be in Farmington, New Mexico, which is in the San Juan Basin, the nation's largest area of on-shore gas production.

The federal agency, which conducted a pilot program on collecting in-kind payments for natural gas federal royalties, said it is considering a variety of proposals to build on lessons learned from the pilot program.
Two hearings were held earlier on gas and oil in-kind royalties, and another on oil in-kind royalties.
